verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a headless mode for scripts and bots, with `--output-format` options of plain, json and streaming-json. It can also run as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout, and `--device-auth` covers headless or remote environments. An independent community comment confirms headless `-p` and ACP for automation and orchestration. Missing for 10: CI-specific integration guidance (e.g. a GitHub Actions or pipeline recipe), documented non-interactive API-key auth for CI runners, and a documented fully non-prompting approval mode (Auto mode notes dangerous tools may still prompt).
